messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Smart-routing anomaly detected — repeated region fallback loop and elevated 5xx for model variants in us-west/eu-west. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
alice (oncall): I got the page, looking now. Seeing spikes in latency and a cascade of fallbacks to the small-quantized variant.
alice (oncall): initial customer impact: increased errors ~12% for some production tenants, latency 2-3x for multi-turn chat.
bob (sre): Can someone post the routing decision logs? need to see why fallback to that variant keeps occurring.
carol (runtime): pulling the router logs, but quick heads up — decision logs only show high-level route name and 'fallback': true. missing variant_id and route_tag in most entries.
dan (ml): that matches what we've seen in rollout — the new variant attribution wasn't wired into the policy decision trace. possible rollout misconfig pinned fallback to v0.9-quant.
eva (prod): customer reports coming in from Support — a handful of enterprise customers saw degraded quality. We've opened a status page draft.
frank (support): I'll triage and escalate to affected accounts, sending templates now.
carol (runtime): log excerpt (redacted):
```
[router] 2026-04-12T14:02:01Z route=smart-route fallback=true reason=capacity signal=us-west->eu-west
[router] 2026-04-12T14:02:02Z route=smart-route fallback=true reason=overload
[router] 2026-04-12T14:02:03Z route=smart-route fallback=true reason=overload
```
carol (runtime): Note: no 'variant' field and no 'decision_id' in entries for the last 3m.
alice (oncall): hypothesis: the policy mis-evaluates cost/latency and keeps choosing the cheap quantized variant; that variant is now overloaded in eu-west and triggers fallbacks in a loop.
bob (sre): mitigation plan: 1) disable smart-routing policy for the impacted route (instant config flip). 2) pin customer-critical tenants to stable model v1.2. 3) enable enhanced decision logging to capture variant and decider.
george (eng-platform): I can flip the flag for the route. Doing a controlled disable now — will publish change in 30s.
ops-bot: config-change: route.smart-route.smart_routing_enabled=false by george at 2026-04-12T14:05:10Z :gear:
frank (support): noting timeline and telling impacted customers we're rolling a mitigation; ETA for fix?
alice (oncall): initial impact reduced immediately after flip. monitoring shows errors falling back to baseline.
carol (runtime): confirming: request volume routed to stable variants increased, error-rate dropping from 12% -> 2% over 3 minutes.
dan (ml): we still need to fix attribution and the policy logic — the root cause is the rollout that didn't populate variant metadata into router decisions. Without that we can't correlate errors to variants.
eva (prod): can we assess how many tenants were served the wrong variant during the window? need concrete numbers for post-incident report.
carol (runtime): current logs only let us approximate via IP and region mapping; without variant tags we only identify impacted customers coarsely.
bob (sre): urgent short-term: 1) add a temporary decision-tagging shim in the router to emit `variant_id` and `route_tag` for all decisions (hotfix). 2) run backfill job to annotate recent decision logs with model-serving node metadata (if node reports variant at serve time).
george (eng-platform): I can push a hotfix branch, but need a quick review. pushing now, will route to canary.
carol (runtime): hotfix patch (pseudo):
```
// router decision emit
decision = evaluate_policies(request)
decision.meta.variant_id = decision.variant or "unknown"
decision.meta.route_tag = decision.route.name
emit(decision_log(decision))
```
carol (runtime): deploying canary with enhanced logs to 10% traffic.
ops-bot: deploy-start: router-hotfix canary by carol at 2026-04-12T14:12:33Z
alice (oncall): handoff: I have to log off in 20m — @bob please take post-mitigation paging and the postmortem lead.
bob (sre): taking handoff. I'll own the timeline and RCA.
frank (support): Support will send follow-up to affected customers noting temporary mitigation and that we're investigating variant attribution; I'll include a tech summary.
dan (ml): follow-ups for ML: audit rollout config that toggles variant metadata emission; add unit tests to ensure variant propagation to decision logs.
george (eng-platform): after canary looks good, we'll promote hotfix and run a backfill script to attach variant ids to the last 45m of decisions where we can infer them.
eva (prod): schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00am with SRE, Runtime, ML and Support. I'll prep the impact spreadsheet (tenants, time windows, error deltas).
bob (sre): initial customer impact estimate: ~6 tenants with severe degradation, 22 tenants minor. total global traffic affected during window ~3% of requests.
alice (oncall): OBSERVABILITY GAP SUMMARY: 1) decision logs missing `variant_id` and `route_tag` 2) no unique `decision_id` to correlate across services 3) metric labels do not include variant attribution.
bob (sre): ACTION ITEMS (assigned): bob - lead RCA & postmortem; carol - roll hotfix to 100% & backfill; dan - audit rollout & add tests; george - add long-term tracing for decision_id; frank/eva - customer comms; alice - update incident timeline notes.
ops-bot: incident-sev: mitigated -> monitoring by ops-bot at 2026-04-12T14:28:50Z
frank (support): status update sent. customers acknowledged; one asked for rollback window and logs.
carol (runtime): final note: while mitigation is in place, we should treat this as a near-miss — the routing loop could have caused broader outage if not quickly detected. will include examples in postmortem.
bob (sre): copying logs and snippets to the postmortem doc. closing pager for now; handing long tail to oncall rotation.
ops-bot: paged->resolved by bob at 2026-04-12T14:30:02Z :white_check_mark:
